title: N-Queens: Count Solutions
description:
Place n queens on an n x n chess board so that no two queens attack each other (no two share a row, column or diagonal). Count how many different placements exist.

Input format
Line 1: n.

Output format
One integer: the number of valid placements.
hints: Each row must contain exactly one queen, so decide the column of the queen row by row.
Use backtracking: for the current row try every column that is not already attacked, place a queen, recurse to the next row, then undo the placement.
Track attacked columns and both diagonals in sets (or bitmasks): column c, diagonal row-c and anti-diagonal row+c identify the lines a queen attacks.

examples.explanation: For a 4 x 4 board there are exactly two arrangements.
One queen on a 1 x 1 board.
